svg.desc: The generation loop: text is tokenized, the model produces a probability for every token, one is sampled, appended to the text, and the whole sequence runs through again.

svg.text: One token at a time. The loop feeds its own output back in.

svg.text: append the chosen token and run the whole thing again

svg.text: 1. It cannot plan ahead - only the next token exists.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. It works in tokens, not letters, so counting letters is hard.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. The pick is random, so the same prompt gives different answers.
